description: Juridinių asmenų vardu Lietuvoje įregistruotų kelių transporto priemonių duomenys is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Akcinė bendrovė „REGITRA“. Date of data collection of road vehicles registered in the Register of Road Vehicles of the Republic of Lithuania on behalf of legal entities. Coverage: Lithuania. The portal shows the English title as "Data on road vehicles registered in Lithuania on behalf of legal entities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Akcinė bendrovė „REGITRA“. Its keywords include Kelių Transporto, Demo, Automobilis, Transporto Priemonė, Transporto Parkas. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
